primitives.name: Accountability Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: The Airwave Ledger gives the take a receipt: it turns what a pundit says on air into a **paraphrased, timestamped, graded claim**, then keeps a running per-pundit **accountability index**.
primitives.assumptions: Claims are binary (hit/miss/push/unfalsifiable), stake is proportional to linguistic emphasis.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When no falsifiable claims exist, index approaches zero due to minimal stake.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic truth assignment through stake-weighted credit accumulation.
layer2.telemetry: Per-pundit index value and claim-level credit/stake ratios.

primitives.name: Grading Spine
primitives.verbatim_quote: This is the realization of the `novus` "grading spine" applied to a new input stream: - **One engine, two outputs** — every settled claim yields (a) an internal signal and (b) a public, redacted ledger row.
primitives.assumptions: Each claim generates deterministic internal and external outputs via shared engine logic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if claim cannot be parsed or classified into valid categories.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's Decision Autopsy pipeline with dual output structure.
layer2.telemetry: Claim classification, internal signal integrity, and redaction compliance.

primitives.name: Refusal as Feature
primitives.verbatim_quote: (`novus` gsn-ops grading spine.) - **Refusal is a feature** — a take too vague to check is recorded *as* unfalsifiable and scores nothing; a pundit who only emits hedges earns a low index even though they are never technically wrong.
primitives.assumptions: Unfalsifiable claims contribute minimal stake but no credit.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Index degrades when majority of claims are non-falsifiable.

layer2.mapping: Encodes GSI's tolerance for hedging through penalty-based degradation of credibility.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of unfalsifiable claims and corresponding index decay rate.
